ns2:course.label: Intro to Algebraic Geometry
ns2:course.description: An introduction to the study of algebraic sets defined by polynomial equations; affine and projective space and their subvarieties; rational and regular functions and mappings; divisors, linear systems, and projective embeddings; birational geometry, blowing up; Grassmannians and other special varieties. Prerequisite: MATH 500.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, MS:Statistics -UIUC, MS:Statistics -- Applied -UIUC, MS: Statistics: Analytics, or MS: Financial Engineering.
